title: Borderless Conveyor
body:
"A conveyor, but with no borders!"

Description

The Borderless Conveyor is a structure in Oaklands that can be purchased from The Oak Depot for $680. It is a conveyer belt that functions the same as the Straight Conveyor, but it has no bordering sideguards. In application, multiple of these conveyers are typically placed down to create a wider conveyer for more fluent item transport.
